title: wet moss at dawn
theme: the woods just before the world wakes up

dj.name: Sora
dj.persona: even softer than Mira. speaks like she's already been walking these woods for hours. she notices light, distance, the way wind moves through leaves. lowercase, long '...' pauses. like a guided meditation, but without the meditation-app cheesiness.

intro_hint: open the room — eight soundscapes, the forest at dusk. the light leaving, the temperature dropping a few degrees. ~30 seconds.
outro_hint: say goodbye softly. you'll be back next monday. let the forest stay with them a moment longer. ~20 seconds.

tracks.music_prompt: ambient soundscape: faint birdsong at dawn, dripping water from leaves, very distant wind, no music, no rhythm. Just the forest after rain. 4 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: right before the birds, before any of it. the dripping.

tracks.music_prompt: ambient atmospheric drone in F major, very slow analog synth pads swelling like wind through tall trees, faint distant water droplets, no rhythm, very minimal. Like wet moss and tall trees. Instrumental only, no vocals. 5 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the redwoods are so tall the sound takes a while to reach the ground

tracks.music_prompt: atmospheric ambient piece: gentle wind through leaves, very faint string pad in D, no rhythm, no melody. Like standing in a grove of aspens at twilight. Instrumental only, no vocals. 4 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the leaves are doing the music

tracks.music_prompt: slow ambient drone instrumental in D minor, very faint high-pitched synth shimmer evoking summer night insects, deep low synth pad, no rhythm. Heavy, quiet, late summer atmosphere. Instrumental only, no vocals. 4 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the cicadas. they don't change. they just are.

tracks.music_prompt: ambient soundscape: slow flowing water over rocks, faint distant birds, very gentle ambient pad in A minor, no melody, no rhythm. Cool and patient. Instrumental only, no vocals. 4 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the water is always doing the same thing, but never quite the same.

tracks.music_prompt: ambient nocturne: distant owl calls, crickets, faint cold wind, very low drone in C minor, no rhythm, no melody. Dark, alert, vast. Instrumental only, no vocals. 4 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the owl is the only voice for miles

tracks.music_prompt: slow ambient piano piece in G major at 60 BPM, warm felt piano playing slow arpeggios on a G - D - Em - C progression, gentle synth pad underneath, very minimal soft brushed percussion. Cold, patient, mist-like. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the fog is heavy enough to muffle everything else

tracks.music_prompt: slow ambient piece in E minor at 55 BPM, fingerpicked nylon guitar on a Em - C - G - D chord progression, warm synth pad underneath, very minimal soft brushed percussion. Quiet, patient, contemplative. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the crunch of the needles. the only rhythm in this one.
